pr_title: roachtest: consider specific cloud config for reuse
pr_body:
We compare the entire spec for cluster reuse including the cloud specific config. This is wrong because if the cloud specific cluster spec differs, we end up creating a new cluster e.g. if we are running the test for GCE and the cluster spec differs for AWS, we can reuse the cluster for GCE.

Fixes: #125476
Epic: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/125477)

> We compare the entire spec for cluster reuse including the cloud specific config. This is wrong because if the cloud specific cluster spec differs, we end up creating a new cluster e.g. if we are running the test for GCE and the cluster spec differs for AWS, we can reuse the cluster for GCE.
> 

I am not following the last sentence. Do you mean that the comparison should extend to considering specs. across different cloud providers?

One thing that also comes to mind with this PR is why we have `ClusterSpec`(s) that have the same definition for GCE, but different params for say AWS. Something about that doesn't feel right, and maybe more like those should be aligned - although I'm not sure how we would enforce something like that, and maybe there is a case for it where it makes sense?
Thanks @herkolategan for the code! I have modified the code and added an UT.

> > We compare the entire spec for cluster reuse including the cloud specific config. This is wrong because if the cloud specific cluster spec differs, we end up creating a new cluster e.g. if we are running the test for GCE and the cluster spec differs for AWS, we can reuse the cluster for GCE.
> 
> I am not following the last sentence. Do you mean that the comparison should extend to considering specs. across different cloud providers?

Sorry for the confusion. It is the other way round. If a specification differs for GCE, cluster reusability check should pass for AWS.
Thanks @herkolategan for the review and suggestions!

issue_context.title: roachtest: cluster reuse config comparison does not consider the cloud it is running in
issue_context.body:
I did some analysis on the cluster variations that we use across tests and how we can reuse clusters for tests.

I noticed that we compare the entire spec for cluster reuse including the cloud specific config. This is wrong because if the cloud specific cluster spec differs, we end up creating a new cluster e.g. if we are running the test in GCE and the cluster spec for the test differs for AWS, we can reuse the cluster for GCE.

Sheet with the cluster spec - https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PCteKFvCPtQq_ELXFpY0br_waBvimfaVnr8YU0Hf95U/edit?usp=sharing

This is a small win today, but, will be useful later.

Jira issue: CRDB-39479
